snippet.title: Democrat Chuck Hubbard's lead grows over Virginia Foxx in NC House race
snippet.description:
North Carolina voters are entering a critical stretch of the 2026 midterm election process, with county election officials preparing to certify results Friday, Nov. 13, while several closely contested races remain unresolved.

Although Election Day was Nov. 3, the process of finalizing election results does not end when polls close. Election officials must finish reviewing provisional ballots, absentee ballots and other outstanding election records before certifying the results.

One of the races drawing particular attention is North Carolina's 5th Congressional District, where Democrat Chuck Hubbard is leading Republican incumbent U.S. Rep. Virginia Foxx by 335 votes, according to the latest figures provided for this report. Foxx has not conceded the race. With the margin within North Carolina's recount threshold, the contest could move into a recount process after Friday's county canvass.

The next several days will be important in determining whether Hubbard's lead holds, whether Foxx formally requests a recount and when voters can expect a final determination. #Politics #Election #ncpol

Garda Revolusi Iran (IRGC) mengklaim telah menyerang dan menghancurkan fasilitas radar peringatan dini milik Amerika Serikat di Bahrain pada Jumat (13/11/2026). 

Serangan udara ini diluncurkan sebagai balasan atas gempuran musuh yang menghantam menara telekomunikasi di Kota Sirik, Provinsi Hormozgan, Iran selatan pada Kamis (12/11/2026). 

IRGC menjelaskan armada jet tempur dari Pasukan Kedirgantaraan mereka berhasil menargetkan dan merusak sistem radar peringatan dini milik pasukan AS di pulau Bahrain. IRGC menegaskan bahwa operasi militer tersebut dilakukan sebagai jawaban cepat atas agresi udara musuh yang sebelumnya merusak infrastruktur telekomunikasi di Sirik.

Have you ever seen a giant rice-drying mat made entirely from bamboo?

This traditional bamboo weaving craft transforms simple bamboo strips into a large, practical drying surface once used in rural farming life.

With patience, skill, and traditional weaving techniques, each bamboo strip becomes part of a beautiful handmade structure.

Long before modern farming equipment, handmade bamboo tools played an important role in everyday agricultural life.

This is more than bamboo weaving. It is a glimpse into traditional farming culture and the craftsmanship passed down through generations.

Would you use a traditional bamboo mat like this?

snippet.title: Call of Duty MW4 Is Secretly Training Gen Z (for better and worse)
snippet.description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is teaching Gen Z a lot more than how to shoot. We compare MW4’s maneuver warfare, night vision, thermal, drones, and CQB against real gear and real tactics, covering what the game gets right and what it gets wrong.
